fields.description: One number patients dial, e.g. 9240276210. Any format is accepted — it is stored and matched as its last 10 digits, because a provider sends the same number both ways ('9240276210' and '+919240276210'). One number per row, and a number may belong to only one rule.
fields.label: DID Number
Label
fields.description: What this number is used for, e.g. 'Niva-Bupa hotline'. Read by people only; nothing routes on it.
Set only when this number lives on a DIFFERENT provider account from the one the rule dials out on — the case of one grain reached through two providers. Left blank, the rule's account carries it.
fields.label: Account Override
Enabled
fields.description: Unticked, an inbound call on this number is no longer attributed to this grain — it is dropped, as any unmapped number is.
